G: the finite undirected graph in the theorem
A: one class of the constructed or assumed bipartition of V(G)
B: the other class of the constructed or assumed bipartition of V(G)
H: an arbitrary connected component of G
r: a chosen root vertex of T
d_T(r,x): the number of edges in the unique path in T from r to x
u: one endpoint of an arbitrary edge of H
v: the other endpoint of that edge
w: the last common vertex of the root-to-u and root-to-v paths in T
P: the unique path in T from u to v
